it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura em 02/04/2026, em solenidade na Câmara Municipal, depois que Adailton Fúria renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a governador na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and took over as mayor on April 2, 2026, in a ceremony at the City Council, after Mayor Adailton Fúria resigned to run for governor in the 2026 election.
